description: Clocks of information processing systems are not synchronized to approved time sources.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not synchronize system clocks across infrastructure components to approved and accurate time sources (NTP servers, atomic clocks), impacting log correlation, forensic investigations, and compliance.

metadata.detection_notes: Review NTP (Network Time Protocol) configurations, time source accuracy and reliability, clock synchronization monitoring, time drift detection, and timestamp accuracy in logs and audit trails.
